title: the spur / bubble clean-up of the assembly (simplify, 11 % of the assembly time) adds nothing on top of fork pruning and can be removed

a.recipe: assemble at the registry settings with clean=False (no spur / bubble removal), same raw outputs; temp/loop21/e259_clean.py

c.recipe: the registry settings (clean=True, spur 5 m, bubble 2.5 m)

rule.note: read from the printout (script, not cards): the clean-up is dropped from the product (candidate; code route with ar-reviewer) only if on ALL seven models Q loses <= 0.003, J <= 0.01, F1@0.5 <= 0.005, vert100 changes <= 0.3, false length rises <= 0.01, with and without the output stage dp_eps 0.2, and the relative saving is >= 0.5 ms; otherwise it stays

kill: none (CPU, 1 thread, about 25 minutes); layer 1 failure (stored card not reproduced) stops the run
